clinician.final_diagnosis: B-ALL associated with a t(1;4) chromosomal abnormality
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 4-year-old girl presented after 20 days of pharyngitis, asthenia, paleness, and fever with a fistulated abscess on the left labia majora. Initial labs showed severe anemia, neutropenia, and thrombocytopenia. Imaging revealed lung parenchymal infiltrates. Bone marrow aspirate demonstrated 97% blast cells confirming acute leukemia. Karyotype analysis identified a clone with t(1;4)(p21;p15) translocation in half of examined mitoses. Complementary FISH studies ruled out MLL gene rearrangements, supporting the diagnosis of B-ALL with the specific t(1;4) chromosomal abnormality.
